frozen_protocol.amendment_reason: Pretrial matched-output hard negative feasibility for degenerate same-output trajectories; source-only first eligible resampling of heldout up to 128 tries, not selected by model outcomes. One gate-parameter ablation test checked all eight ternary values rather than one accidentally equivalent trajectory.

sourcefree_cases.author: Internal ChatGPT-authored separated source-only generator; NOT independently sourced or authenticated external science.
sourcefree_cases.meta_novelty: Binary NAND, XOR and AND causal law tasks. Source task labels and operator identities not shown to learners.

arms.learns: NAND truth table from meta tasks; infers unknown ternary truth table and input wiring from heldout FIT; synthesizes complete causal circuit from learned NAND and executes role-bound state recurrently.
XOR/AND truth tables from same meta tasks; independently infers new ternary truth table/wiring from same heldout FIT; fits full three-bit algebraic normal form, not candidate code.

arms.limitation: Removes learned gate needed by constructor, so no program can form. Diagnostic proof of parameter influence, NOT capacity-matched compute nor a full alternative strong learner.
Restricted historical two-input control, not equally meta-trained; no meaningful superiority claim.

science_interpretation.bounded_sourcefree_positive: For two synthetic families absent from meta-training and with newly sampled role wiring, learned gate compiler constructs majority3 and conditional selector3 as full reusable gate DAGs, predicts all 64 accepted eight-event positive holdouts and rejects 64 same-output-inventory role-distinct hard negatives.
science_interpretation.explicit_source_class_limit: Both candidate and equally trained peer are supplied a finite hypothesis family of arbitrary THREE-input Boolean operators over 5 possible public causal nibble registers. The source author uses exactly three-input bitwise operators. Thus this is genuine new high-level primitive TYPE relative to meta tasks but NOT unrestricted discovery of an unknown operator arity or physical computational primitive.
science_interpretation.strong_peer_tie: The independent peer, trained on exactly the same twelve public meta tasks and heldout FIT, matches 64/64 and zero false positives. No accuracy advantage to candidate.
science_interpretation.compute_failure: Candidate complete OS CPU median 218.007ms vs independent peer 68.0405ms (majority 3.204x) and 178.458ms vs peer 55.3515ms (selector 3.224x). Candidate is materially slower; exact matched FLOPs/work equivalence not established, so no resource nonregression approval. Candidate RSS slightly lower by ~0.15–0.28 MiB; memory observations alone cannot rescue compute.
science_interpretation.quartic_negative: Both ternary learners cannot fit the genuine four-input AND/XOR interaction; this is a correctly scoped out-of-class negative. Both naturally abstain and thus heldout hard negatives were NOT SCORED. A zero diagnostic counter for an unfit model is not a zero error rate.
science_interpretation.learned_parameter_influence: Counterfactual replacing FIT-learned NAND truth table with constant zero changes compiled gate behavior on the finite full 3-bit truth-table domain. Removing the gate causes no program construction, a mechanism-dependence ablation but not a trained capacity-matched peer.
science_interpretation.scientific_authenticity: The heldout structural families were authored internally in source-only code by the same assistant process, deterministic and isolated from model imports. They are NOT independently originated/authenticated FSA first-use tasks; no authentic external holdout scientific claim supported.
science_interpretation.next_research: F124-DD must prioritize reducing complete CPU cost while preserving equal strong trained control and genuinely independent new-source structural variation. Learn compact native operator programs (ANF, BDD or search-conditioned minimal DAG) rather than expensive naive NAND DNF compiler. Verify parameter influence and native cost parity on source-free unseen four-variable/non-boolean structural cases before considering any new original scientific first-use.
